Description: The components required to deliver a health workforce that has the skills, experience and knowledge to apply eHealth in the management and delivery of care to individuals.
Examples:
eHealth skills and competencies that health workers require
Education and training (development, integration or changes to existing curricula) required to develop an eHealth-ready health workforce
eHealth accreditation requirements for health workers
Priority segments of the nation’s health workforce
Implications for workforce change and adoption

Description: The same components as above but applied to designing, building, operating and supporting eHealth services.
Examples: As above, but applicable to ICT workers
